questions.stem: How do Data Provenance and Data Lineage relate to each other?
options: They are completely unrelated activities
Logically they do the same thing but at different levels of granularity
Data Provenance is a technical subset of Data Lineage
Data Lineage applies to business data and Data Provenance to technical logs
Data Provenance is the older name for Data Lineage
questions.explanation: Both describe the data lifecycle; Data Lineage does it at the level of databases, tables and columns, while Data Provenance works at a higher level.

questions.stem: At what level does Data Provenance describe the data lifecycle?
options: Individual rows and cell values
Databases, tables and columns
Network packets and ports
Inputs, entities, systems and processes
File paths and directory names
questions.explanation: Data Provenance is at a higher level, dealing with inputs, entities, systems and processes rather than technical objects.

questions.stem: Which of the following details belongs to Data Lineage rather than Data Provenance?
options: Which database, table and column the data came from and went into
Whether real-time or batch processing was used
Which entity the data relates to
Whether analytical modelling was performed
Which source system supplied the data
questions.explanation: Data Lineage tracks the data lifecycle in terms of databases, tables, columns and the business or ETL rules applied between them.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a question Data Provenance answers?
options: Which column was renamed during the ETL job
Which index is defined on the target table
How many bytes the source file occupied
Which foreign key links two tables
Whether the data was processed in real time, in batches or by events
questions.explanation: Data Provenance records the process used, such as real-time, batch or event-based processing, along with format, source system and entity.

options: Database administrators
ETL developers
Business users and management
Network engineers
Security testers
questions.explanation: Data Provenance is used by business users or management, whereas Data Lineage is mostly used by IT staff.

options: IT staff
Board members
External auditors only
Customers
Marketing managers
questions.explanation: Data Lineage is mostly used by IT folks because it deals with databases, tables, columns and ETL rules.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT listed as something Data Provenance captures during the data lifecycle?
options: Any data cleaning that took place
Any data quality rules applied
The index defined on a particular table column
Any data enrichment that took place
Master and reference data management activities
questions.explanation: Data Provenance records cleaning, quality rules, enrichment, metadata management and master and reference data management; column-level index details are a technical matter outside its scope.

questions.stem: Which processing styles does Data Provenance record as part of describing how data was handled?
options: Compiled, interpreted and scripted
Encrypted, hashed and tokenised
Primary, secondary and tertiary
Local, regional and global
Real-time, batch and event-based
questions.explanation: Data Provenance notes whether the process used was real-time processing, batch processing or event-based processing.

questions.stem: Which of the following is something Data Provenance records about incoming data?
options: The width of each column in characters
The format it arrives in and the source system it comes from
The password of the source system
The SQL used to create the target table
The number of rows in each partition
questions.explanation: Data Provenance records the format the data comes in, the source system, the related entity and the processes applied to it.

questions.stem: What does a Data Lineage record capture when data moves from one table to another?
options: The cost of the storage used
The name of the business sponsor
The reason the project was approved
The business rules incorporated during the transformation between source and target database, table and column
The regulatory framework governing the data
questions.explanation: Data Lineage tracks which database, table and column data came from and went into, with the business rules applied during transformation.
